headline: Full-length and depth-aware isoform profiling expands heart and aging transcriptomes, paired with portals
label: Isoform Resolved Transcriptome Tooling
summary: Long-read heart isoform atlas, mouse aging isoform switching and splicing depth guidelines show isoform-level analysis needs matched sequencing and accessible tools.
synthesis: The dominant thread is isoform-level transcriptome resolution paired with tools for access and interpretation. A PacBio HiFi atlas of non-failing, DCM and IHD human left ventricles reports 15,535 novel isoforms, augmented GENCODE and the CardioIsoMap portal. A mouse multi-tissue atlas finds age-associated differential transcript usage across brain, liver and adipose that is predominantly regulatory, with BioEMU modeling used to test structural effects. Deep RNA-seq analysis shows typical depths miss alternative splicing and provides depth guidelines and a website. Adjacent items are proteomics and matrisome tools (OSMSS, qPTM 3.0, ECMExplainer, ScarX, msiFlow 2.0, CFxplorer) that share the interactive-resource format but are not isoform-focused.
